subject: Recap: Horizon Health — SDK + embeddings/rerank integration next steps
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Horizon Health — SDK + embeddings/rerank integration next steps

Hi Maya / Liam,

Thanks again for a great call today — appreciate you walking us through the clinical triage flows and the latency/regulatory constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same picture. TL;DR: Horizon needs consistent reranking at <200ms P95, better embedding stability for cold-start cases, and a streaming SDK path to surface partial scores into your triage UI.

Pain points we heard
- Reranker latency spikes when batch sizes vary; current model pipeline produces inconsistent ordering across runs.
- Embedding drift for new providers/patient notes — causes poor nearest-neighbor matches.
- Need structured outputs + function calling to integrate with your routing engine (so downstream services can consume discrete fields rather than free text).
- Regulatory: data residency for PHI-concerned props (you mentioned EU patients routed to EU region).

Goals you stated
1) Achieve rerank P95 < 200ms for single-query rerank on 8k context windows.
2) Stable embedding vectors for incremental indexing workflows.
3) Streaming inference with partial rerank scores surfaced to UI within 100ms for early UX.
4) Clear plan for procurement/timeline (you mentioned procurement window in 6–8 weeks).

What Redwood will deliver (next/near-term)
- PoC SDK change: add a streaming rerank helper + example for incremental embeddings ingestion (we'll send a patch for your engineering review). Attachment: horizon-mqp-sdk-diff.patch
- Short eval kit: a focused prompt set and embedding quality checks to validate drift and metric thresholds.
- Runbook for routing with function-calls + schema suggestion for your triage engine.
- Initial capacity and pricing note attached for procurement (horizon-procurement-quote.pdf).

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA)
- Redwood: send SDK patch + sample code by Wed 2026-06-03 (Dylan).
- Horizon: share one anonymized sample note set and the triage schema by Fri 2026-06-05 (Maya).
- Redwood + Horizon: schedule a 60-min technical session to walk through patch + metrics on Mon 2026-06-08.

If that lines up, I'll loop in Aditya for a quick pricing alignment call after your procurement team gives a sense of timing.

Thanks again — excited to move this forward.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
<aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Aisha — this is helpful and captures what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: correct on the 6–8 week window; legal will want the SOC 2 + data processing terms up front. Can you share SOC 2 report and a sketch of the DPS?
- Data residency: for EU patients we need the inference and logs to remain in eu-central-1. Are there any limitations to using the streaming SDK in a regional deployment?
- Sample data: we'll send an anonymized batch of ~2k notes (stripped PHI) by Friday.

Also, for the triage schema we expect the reranker to return a structured score object like:
{"score": 0.0, "reasons": ["keyword_match", "recency"], "explainability_tokens": ["...snippet..."]}

Would love to see how the function-calling output maps to that.

—Maya
Maya Ortiz
Director, Clinical Data Science
Horizon Health

On Tue, Jun 1, 2026 at 5:38 PM Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@horizonhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Aisha — this is helpful and captures what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 
> 
> - Procurement: correct on the 6–8 week window; legal will want the SOC 2 + data processing terms up front. Can you share SOC 2 report and a sketch of the DPS?
> - Data residency: for EU patients we need the inference and logs to remain in eu-central-1. Are there any limitations to using the streaming SDK in a regional deployment?
> - Sample data: we'll send an anonymized batch of ~2k notes (stripped PHI) by Friday.
> 
> Also, for the triage schema we expect the reranker to return a structured score object like:
> {"score": 0.0, "reasons": ["keyword_match", "recency"], "explainability_tokens": ["...snippet..."]}

Hi Maya — quick answers from my end: 
1) SOC 2: I'll attach the SOC 2 Type II summary and a short DPS sketch in a separate secure link (we don't attach full reports over email). Expect an email with a secure drive link from me by EOD.
2) Regional streaming: streaming is supported in regional deployments. The only limitation today is that cross-region fallback (automatic) will default to the nearest available compatible model; we can gate that behavior for EU-residency clients so fails never cross-region.
3) Function-calling / structured outputs: The SDK patch includes an example function schema and a streaming helper that emits partial rerank explanations as they become available. Sample snippet (from the patch):

--- begin snippet ---
# python pseudo-code for streaming rerank helper
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient(region='eu-central-1', model='rwd/rerank-v1')
for partial in client.stream_rerank(query, candidates):
    # partial = {"candidate_id": ..., "score": 0.83, "reasons": ["keyword_match"], "explain_snip": "..."}
    ui.emit_partial_score(partial)
--- end snippet ---

I'll upload the patch to the secure drive and include the patch filename (horizon-mqp-sdk-diff.patch). Dylan

Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

Aditya — forwarding the thread. Quick notes for pricing call prep:

- Horizon is a mid-market health system; procurement in 6–8 weeks; expects regional isolation for EU patients.
- Technical ask: streaming rerank with partial scores, structured function-calls for triage routing, embedding stability verification.
- Deliverables we promised: SDK patch + sample code (Dylan EOD 6/2), eval kit, secure SOC 2 link, quote (attached).

Suggested next steps before we get on price call:
1) Confirm we can commit to EU-only processing for their EU patient traffic (ops/legal).
2) Draft a 90-day PoC SOW with acceptance criteria: rerank P95 <200ms, embedding recall@10 > 0.85 on their sample set.
3) Prepare a redwood-side checklist for PHI handling during the PoC (KMS settings, ephemeral logging).

Can you join the tech walkthrough on Mon 6/8 and then the pricing sync after the sample is loaded?

Thanks,
Aisha
